name: After § 247, point iii
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: (iii a) prioritise occupational health and safety, including psychosocial risks (stress, burnout, harassment); it must officially recognize psychosocial risks as occupational hazards and adopt a Parliament-wide prevention plan with measurable objectives; it must implement risk assessments covering telework, business trips, and tight deadlines, as well as confidential reporting channels, training for managers, and regular social dialogue; it insists on the enforcement of the right to disconnect;
